name: cards-demo-2
title: Author Blog Card
description: A tall editorial card with a night city skyline behind an avatar, author name and read time at the top, and a title with a short paragraph at the bottom. Hovering darkens the photo.
use: A blog or editorial grid needs post cards that pair an author byline with a moody photo.
avoid: The copy and avatar are hardcoded, and the only response is a darkening overlay on hover.
a11y: The avatar has alt text, but the card has no link or focus state and the hover darkening is unreachable by keyboard. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall rounded card with a dark photo of a city waterfront at night behind a faint overlay. Top left holds a small round avatar beside "Manu Arora" and "2 min read", with the heading "Author Card" and a short paragraph at the bottom.
behaves: Hovering deepens a black overlay across the photo so the skyline dims and the white text stands out. Nothing else moves, and leaving restores the lighter image.
customise: Nothing is exposed; the name, read time, heading, paragraph, avatar path and photo URL all live in the file.
weight: light: One image card with a CSS hover overlay and a single remote photo.
